text:
Nora: Quick update — midday pop-up demo at the pavilion. Need to finalize: speaker swap, mic + table, QR lead flow, and last-minute swag counts. Who can take speaker escort?
Raj: I can do escort. ETA to venue 11:20am. What time is demo?
Nora: Demo at 12:15pm. Swap: original speaker Sam had a flight; Cass is stepping in. Cass: you good to run the 12:15 slot?
Cass: Yep, Ill take it. Need slides (2x 5min sections) and a 1-slide benchmark highlight.
Bea: AV: we have a single portable speaker, one wired mic, one lav. Need a table for laptop + dongles. OpsBot: confirm table delivery?
OpsBot: Table delivery scheduled 11:00am. Setup crew will place at booth B7.
Theo: Lead capture — we'll use one iPad + paper fallback. Tagging: hot (request demo), warm (newsletter), partner. Export filename: popup_leads_1767891234.csv
Nora: Perfect. Bea please do mic check at 11:50. Cass: send slides to me and Theo by 11:05 so we can preload.
Cass: Sent slides to Nora via DM. Also adding a benchmark bullet: "median latency 85ms, 3x cheaper than baseline" on slide 3.
Raj: Swag update: sticker pack 150, mini tote 80, buttons 100. Suggest holding back 20 hoodies for VIPs only.
Bea: Power note — bring 6ft extension and USB-C adapter. I'll pack an extra battery.
Nora: Lead routing rules: hot -> DM Raj + add to demos queue; warm -> marketing drip; partner -> Ops to route. Theo: confirm CSV header names.
Theo: Header: name,email,company,title,tag,notes,source. We'll ensure iPad exports match.
Nora: Great. Post-demo follow-up: 24hr email with slide link and benchmark signup. Cass to send a 1-paragraph bio for the follow-up.
Cass: Bio sent.
Raj: On my way.
Bea: Packing now.
Nora: Thanks team — see you at 11. :white_check_mark:
